Chapter 596: Chapter 29: Twilight of the Gods (Subscribe Please)

Outside the Longshan Great Hall.

Many members of the Longshan Family, trembling in spirit, looked up at the sky.

There, massive stars fell from the heavens like raindrops.

It was not merely a few stars falling, but large swathes and indeed every star across the entire sky.

This was simply unthinkable.

Everyone’s mind was muddled, staring dumbfounded at the shocking scene before them.

...

You must understand, in this world, the stars above were not just stars; they were the abode of the gods in the Divine Kingdoms, symbolizing the immortality of the deities.

Even those without any belief held the stars above with utmost reverence, the pinnacle of what life could achieve.

For ages, in nearly everyone’s eyes, the stars above were eternal, unchanged from their birth until their death, and from their descendants’ birth until their death, always the same stars.

Thus, to many people, the stars above seemed as eternal as the world itself.

But now, the worldview of many members of the Longshan Family began to shatter as the stars all began to fall simultaneously.

“What’s going on?”

“The stars, those are the Divine Kingdoms of the deities, how could they fall?”

“The fall of the Divine Kingdoms means the deities are perishing, but how is that possible?”

“Deities are immortal, how could they perish?”

The members of the Longshan Family couldn’t believe it, some even thought they were dreaming, slapping themselves several times, only to find they could still feel pain, horror nearly overflowing in their hearts.

“This is bad, the clan leader just entered the Ocean of Light.”

“The rapid fall of the Divine Kingdoms clearly indicates something drastic has happened in the Ocean of Light and the Abyss of Darkness. Could something have happened to the clan leader?”

A few heads of the Longshan Family thought further, Lin Yuan was a pillar of their clan, about to lead the family to the peak of the Plateau of Myriad Nations, and now this had happened?

“I hope nothing has happened to the clan leader.”

A few elders of the Longshan Family silently thought.

…

Above the sky, countless stars that had hung in the sky for eons began to fall all at once, and not only the Longshan Family could see it.

At this moment, in the vast realms of humanity, Plateau of Myriad Nations, and other places teeming with life, beings also noticed the changes above.

“Are the stars falling?”

“Are the deities perishing?”

“How is this possible? How could so many deities perish at once?”

In many secluded corners, demigods who had survived tens or hundreds of thousands of years were equally stunned.

They had lived longer, knew the history of the past, and were aware of the existence of “Divine Wars.”

Deities were not incapable of perishing, it was just that they lived for so long that almost all beings believed them to be eternal.

But in reality, deities could die, such as during the “Divine Wars.”

During a “Divine War,” True Gods of the Ocean of Light and the Abyss of Darkness would slaughter each other, leading to the perishing of deities.

But even in the most brutal Divine Wars, the death of several dozen or even hundreds of deities was the maximum, but now? The number of fallen stars is in the thousands?

Many demigod veterans felt their hearts slow, because the scene before them was too soul-shattering, some even wondered if the gods of the Ocean of Light and the Abyss of Darkness had been wiped out in one fell swoop?

Otherwise, how could so many stars fall at once?

“What exactly is going on?”

“What really happened in the Ocean of Light and the Abyss of Darkness?”

“Could it be that the twenty-four Prime Gods are jointly slaughtering the deities?”

Many demigod veterans couldn’t help but speculate in this direction, their faces unconsciously showing fear.

The only ones capable of causing such mass perishing of True Gods were the Prime Gods, and not just one but twenty-four Prime Gods in a joint massacre.

If even one Prime God disagreed and resisted, the frequency of falling stars wouldn’t be this rapid.

From the area and range of the falling stars, demigod veterans vaguely deduced that a one-sided massacre of True Gods was taking place in the Ocean of Light or the Abyss of Darkness.

This massacre was one-sided, with the slaughtered True Gods having no power to resist.

This made all the demigod veterans somewhat disheartened; they did not know how much they had sacrificed to ignite their divine fire, step into the seventh level, then lie in hiding, secretly gathering faith, hoping to consolidate a Divine Kingdom, and elevating it.

And yet, now they saw the True Gods, whom they considered their ultimate goal, being slaughtered in the Ocean of Light and the Abyss of Darkness like pigs and dogs.

Could the deities they revered so highly also have such weak moments when they couldn’t determine their own fates and could only wait to die?

For a moment, many demigod veterans were unstable, and the divine fires they had ignited began to flicker.

What’s the use of gathering faith anymore? Elevating which Divine Kingdom? Even if one became a True God and entered the Ocean of Light, what could they do?

It might not even be as safe or as comfortable as the human realm.

“Why would the Prime Gods slaughter the True Gods?”

“For faith? That doesn’t make sense. The twenty-four Prime Gods already occupy the majority of faith in humanity, even if they cleanse all the True Gods, their own faith won’t undergo a qualitative change.”

“Is it because they are worried about their positions being threatened? That’s also unlikely. Not to mention the power disparity between a Prime God and a True God, the number of Prime Gods is fixed. Even if there were an outstandingly talented True God, without the True God Form, they still couldn’t become a Prime God, let alone shake the position of a Prime God.”
